notes:
Replication values are author-derived primary master-table values, retained as printed. Corrupted Greek metric labels preserved; no conversion performed. Table sample N is not independently established as analytic N. Original: DOI landing returned 403; OpenAlex/Unpaywall supplied no open-access full-text location; additional available author/repository routes did not yield the full original. Replication-source original statistics were not substituted. Primary table matches Winawer, Huk and Boroditsky title, Study 3 and motion aftereffect outcome; its Project URL is https://osf.io/mjasz/, while input names https://osf.io/ertbg. Exact supplied-project sample identity is unverified. 
Source follow-up: Published article version, exact title/authors verified on supplied canonical text. Rendered PDF pages 3–5 inspected. No manuscript or embedded appendix substituted. Canonical text renders equals signs as "5" and plus/minus as U+0006; exact quote glyphs retained. Rendered page 5 confirms t(28) = 4.98 and p = .000 for normalized coherence. The separately printed actual-coherence test is t(28) = 5.48, p = .000; not combined with the selected test. Analytic n=29 is established by the explicit 32-person Experiment 3 sample and three exclusions, not printed as a standalone total; t(28) and the debriefing accounting of 24 respondents plus 5 nonrespondents corroborate it. Printed p=.000 retained as an equality without reinterpreting its precision. Unassigned replication and narrative-success fields intentionally left unavailable.
